paper_title: Near-quantum-limited axion dark matter search with the ORGAN experiment around 26 $μ$eV
coupling_convention: |g_agammagamma| in GeV^-1, exactly as plotted on the y-axis
notes: ORGAN-Q haloscope (near-quantum-limited phase of ORGAN) excludes |g_agamma| >~ 2.8e-13 GeV^-1 at 95% CL over 25.45-26.27 ueV (6.15-6.35 GHz), assuming axions comprise 100% of local DM with rho = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and standard Maxwell-Boltzmann halo lineshape. Only the headline coupling value is given in text (bin-by-bin limits are in Fig. 4, not tabulated), so the limit is encoded as a flat two-point line over the scanned mass range.
